params.name: side
params.reference:
On entry, `SIDE` specifies whether op( A ) appears on the left or right of X as follows:

$$
\mathrm{SIDE} = \text{'L'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'l'} \operatorname{op}( A ) \, X = \alpha \, B
$$

$$
\mathrm{SIDE} = \text{'R'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'r'} X \, \operatorname{op}( A ) = \alpha \, B
$$

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
On entry, `UPLO` specifies whether the matrix A is an upper or lower triangular matrix as follows:

`UPLO = 'U'` or 'u' A is an upper triangular matrix.

`UPLO = 'L'` or 'l' A is a lower triangular matrix.

params.name: transa
params.reference:
On entry, `TRANSA` specifies the form of op( A ) to be used in the matrix multiplication as follows:

$$
\mathrm{TRANSA} = \text{'N'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'n'} \operatorname{op}( A ) = A
$$

$$
\mathrm{TRANSA} = \text{'T'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'t'} \operatorname{op}( A ) = A^T
$$

$$
\mathrm{TRANSA} = \text{'C'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'c'} \operatorname{op}( A ) = A^H
$$

params.name: diag
params.reference:
On entry, `DIAG` specifies whether or not A is unit triangular as follows:

`DIAG = 'U'` or 'u' A is assumed to be unit triangular.

`DIAG = 'N'` or 'n' A is not assumed to be unit

triangular.

params.name: M
params.reference: On entry, M specifies the number of rows of B. M must be at least zero.

params.name: N
params.reference: On entry, N specifies the number of columns of B. N must be at least zero.

params.name: alpha
params.reference: On entry, `ALPHA` specifies the scalar $\alpha$. When $\alpha$ is zero then A is not referenced and B need not be set before entry.

params.name: A
params.reference:
where k is m when `SIDE = 'L'` or 'l'

$$
\quad\text{and}\quad k \mathrm{is} n \quad\text{when}\quad \mathrm{SIDE} = \text{'R'} \quad\text{or}\quad \text{'r'}
$$

Before entry with `UPLO = 'U'` or 'u', the leading k by k upper triangular part of the array A must contain the upper triangular matrix and the strictly lower triangular part of A is not referenced. Before entry with `UPLO = 'L'` or 'l', the leading k by k lower triangular part of the array A must contain the lower triangular matrix and the strictly upper triangular part of A is not referenced. Note that when `DIAG = 'U'` or 'u', the diagonal elements of A are not referenced either, but are assumed to be unity.

params.name: lda
params.reference: On entry, `LDA` specifies the first dimension of A as declared in the calling (sub) program. When `SIDE = 'L'` or 'l' then `LDA` must be at least max( 1, m ), when `SIDE = 'R'` or 'r' then `LDA` must be at least max( 1, n ).

params.name: B
params.reference: Before entry, the leading m by n part of the array B must contain the right-hand side matrix B, and on exit is overwritten by the solution matrix X.

params.name: ldb
params.reference: On entry, `LDB` specifies the first dimension of B as declared in the calling (sub) program. `LDB` must be at least max( 1, m ).
